theorems.name: Submission.rsod_lipschitz_range_subset_c1_ranges
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (F : Rn n → Amb n ℓ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K F → ∃ (N₀ : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (G : ℕ → Rn n → Amb n ℓ), (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) N₀ = 0 ∧ (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (G k)) ∧ range F ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃ k, range (G k)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
